claim: The universe originated approximately 13.8 billion years ago in a hot, dense state (the Big Bang), as evidenced by the cosmic microwave background, primordial nucleosynthesis ratios, and the expansion of space

evidence.title: Planck 2018 Results VI: Cosmological Parameters
evidence.finding: The Planck satellite measured the age of the universe as 13.787 +/- 0.020 billion years from CMB anisotropy analysis, the most precise determination to date

evidence.title: Big Bang Nucleosynthesis (Annual Reviews)
evidence.finding: The observed abundances of hydrogen, helium, deuterium, and lithium match predictions from Big Bang nucleosynthesis to high precision, independently confirming the hot dense origin

scoreReasoning.correspondence: CMB measured to extraordinary precision by Planck; nucleosynthesis ratios independently confirm the hot dense state; Hubble expansion directly observed
scoreReasoning.coherence: Integrates general relativity, nuclear physics, and thermodynamics into a single consistent cosmological model
scoreReasoning.convergence: Mainstream consensus in cosmology; Hubble tension (67 vs 73 km/s/Mpc) creates uncertainty in exact age but not in the Big Bang framework itself
scoreReasoning.pragmatism: All of modern cosmology, particle physics, and astrophysics builds on the Big Bang framework

claim: The solar system formed approximately 4.567 billion years ago from the gravitational collapse of a molecular cloud, as dated by uranium-lead measurements of the oldest meteoritic inclusions

evidence.title: The Absolute Chronology and Thermal Processing of Solids in the Solar Protoplanetary Disk (Geochimica)
evidence.finding: Calcium-aluminum-rich inclusions (CAIs) in meteorites date to 4567.30 +/- 0.16 Ma by Pb-Pb methods, marking the oldest solids in the solar system

evidence.title: A Revised Age for the Formation of the Solar System (Science)
evidence.finding: Multiple radiometric systems (U-Pb, Hf-W, Al-Mg) converge on a solar system formation age of 4.567 Gyr with sub-million-year precision

scoreReasoning.correspondence: U-Pb dating of CAIs achieves 0.003% precision; multiple independent isotope systems agree; 50+ meteorites measured consistently
scoreReasoning.coherence: Follows from gravitational collapse theory; consistent with stellar evolution models and observed protoplanetary disks around young stars
scoreReasoning.convergence: Universal scientific consensus; no competing chronology for solar system formation exists in peer-reviewed literature
scoreReasoning.pragmatism: Foundation for all planetary science, asteroid deflection planning, and understanding Earth's place in cosmic history

claim: Life existed on Earth by at least 3.5 billion years ago, evidenced by stromatolite fossils in the Pilbara Craton and carbon isotope fractionation signatures in the Isua Greenstone Belt

evidence.title: Earliest Signs of Life on Land Preserved in ca. 3.5 Ga Hot Spring Deposits (Nature Ecology & Evolution)
evidence.finding: Stromatolites in the 3.48 Ga Dresser Formation (Pilbara, Australia) show layered structures consistent with microbial mat formation, preserved in hot spring environments

evidence.title: Rapid Emergence of Life Shown by Discovery of 3,700-Million-Year-Old Microbial Structures (Nature)
evidence.finding: Carbon-13 depleted graphite in 3.7 Ga Isua rocks (Greenland) shows isotope fractionation consistent with biological carbon fixation, though abiotic explanations are debated

scoreReasoning.correspondence: Stromatolites at 3.48 Ga are well-accepted; earlier claims (3.7-4.1 Ga) remain debated but carbon isotope evidence is strong
scoreReasoning.coherence: Consistent with molecular clock estimates for the last universal common ancestor (LUCA) and early Earth geochemistry
scoreReasoning.convergence: Broad agreement that life existed by 3.5 Ga; exact timing of origin (3.5 vs 3.8 vs 4.0 Ga) is actively debated
scoreReasoning.pragmatism: Understanding the origin and early history of life informs astrobiology, evolutionary biology, and the search for extraterrestrial life

claim: Complex multicellular animal life diversified rapidly beginning approximately 541 million years ago in the Cambrian explosion, producing most modern animal phyla within 20-25 million years

evidence.title: Calibrating the Cambrian Explosion of Animals (Science)
evidence.finding: U-Pb zircon dating constrains the base of the Cambrian to 538.8 +/- 0.2 Ma; the main burst of diversification occurred within ~20 Myr, producing all major animal body plans

evidence.title: The Cambrian Explosion: Current Status (Annual Reviews)
evidence.finding: The Burgess Shale (508 Ma) and Chengjiang biota (518 Ma) preserve extraordinary soft-bodied fossils documenting the rapid appearance of arthropods, chordates, mollusks, and other phyla

scoreReasoning.correspondence: Precisely dated by U-Pb methods; exceptional fossil preservation at Burgess Shale and Chengjiang provides direct morphological evidence
scoreReasoning.coherence: Consistent with molecular clock estimates and with increasing atmospheric oxygen (Great Oxidation Event) enabling larger body sizes
scoreReasoning.convergence: Universal scientific agreement on the timing and reality of the Cambrian explosion; causes remain debated (ecological, genetic, environmental)
scoreReasoning.pragmatism: Establishes the origin of all major animal body plans; foundational for comparative anatomy, evolutionary biology, and understanding biodiversity

claim: A mass extinction event 66 million years ago at the Cretaceous-Paleogene boundary eliminated approximately 76% of all species, including non-avian dinosaurs, driven primarily by the Chicxulub asteroid impact

evidence.title: The Chicxulub Asteroid Impact and Mass Extinction at the Cretaceous-Paleogene Boundary (Science)
evidence.finding: High-precision 40Ar/39Ar dating places the Chicxulub impact at 66.043 +/- 0.011 Ma, indistinguishable from the K-Pg boundary, confirming the impact as the primary extinction trigger

evidence.title: Global Iridium Anomaly at the K-Pg Boundary (Science)
evidence.finding: The global iridium layer at the K-Pg boundary, first identified by Alvarez et al. (1980), has been confirmed at 350+ sites worldwide, matching extraterrestrial composition

scoreReasoning.correspondence: Chicxulub crater precisely dated; global iridium anomaly at 350+ sites; shocked quartz and tsunami deposits provide direct physical evidence
scoreReasoning.coherence: Impact → dust cloud → photosynthesis shutdown → food chain collapse is a physically coherent extinction mechanism
scoreReasoning.convergence: Strong consensus that Chicxulub was the primary trigger; Deccan Traps volcanism contributed but impact was dominant
scoreReasoning.pragmatism: Understanding mass extinctions informs planetary defense (asteroid deflection), biodiversity conservation, and climate catastrophe modeling

claim: Anatomically modern Homo sapiens emerged in Africa approximately 300,000 years ago, as evidenced by fossils at Jebel Irhoud (Morocco) and Omo Kibish (Ethiopia), with genetic evidence confirming an African origin for all modern humans

evidence.title: New Fossils from Jebel Irhoud and the Pan-African Origin of Homo sapiens (Nature)
evidence.finding: Thermoluminescence dating of Jebel Irhoud fossils yields 315 +/- 34 ka, pushing back the earliest known Homo sapiens by 100,000 years and supporting a pan-African origin

evidence.title: Genetic History of an Archaic Hominin Group from Denisova Cave (Nature)
evidence.finding: Ancient DNA analysis confirms that all non-African modern humans descend from a single Out-of-Africa migration ~60-70 ka, with limited admixture from Neanderthals (1-4%) and Denisovans

scoreReasoning.correspondence: Jebel Irhoud fossils directly dated; mtDNA and whole-genome analyses independently confirm African origin; molecular clock calibration consistent with fossil dates
scoreReasoning.coherence: Integrates fossil morphology, radiometric dating, ancient DNA, and population genetics into a coherent narrative of human origins
scoreReasoning.convergence: Broad consensus on African origin and ~300 ka emergence; some debate on multiregional vs. replacement models but genetic evidence strongly favors Out-of-Africa
scoreReasoning.pragmatism: Understanding human origins informs medicine (genetic diversity and disease), forensics, migration policy, and our shared identity as a species

claim: The agricultural revolution beginning approximately 12,000 years ago in the Fertile Crescent independently arose in multiple regions, enabling permanent settlements, population growth, and the emergence of complex civilizations

evidence.title: The Origins of Agriculture in the Near East (Science)
evidence.finding: Archaeobotanical evidence from the Fertile Crescent shows deliberate cultivation of emmer wheat and barley by 10,500-9,500 BCE, with animal domestication (goats, sheep) following by 8,500 BCE

evidence.title: Gobekli Tepe and the Dawn of Civilization (Antiquity)
evidence.finding: Gobekli Tepe (ca. 9,500 BCE), a monumental ceremonial site built by pre-agricultural hunter-gatherers, suggests complex social organization preceded or co-evolved with farming

scoreReasoning.correspondence: C-14 dated plant and animal remains directly document the transition; multiple independent sites confirm the timeline across continents
scoreReasoning.coherence: Agriculture → surplus → specialization → cities → writing is a coherent causal chain supported by archaeological sequences at multiple sites
scoreReasoning.convergence: Universal agreement on the independent origins of agriculture in at least 7 regions; debate is about causes (climate, population pressure, social) not the event itself
scoreReasoning.pragmatism: The Neolithic revolution is the foundation of all subsequent civilization — cities, states, writing, technology, and the modern world all depend on agricultural surplus

claim: A continuous, evidence-based chronology from the Big Bang (13.8 Gyr) through solar system formation (4.567 Gyr), the origin of life (3.5 Gyr), complex animal life (541 Myr), mass extinction (66 Myr), human emergence (300 kyr), and agricultural civilization (12 kyr) is established by converging radiometric, geological, biological, and historical evidence

evidence.title: A Geologic Time Scale 2020 (GSA Special Paper)
evidence.finding: The International Commission on Stratigraphy maintains a continuously refined geologic time scale integrating radiometric, biostratigraphic, and magnetostratigraphic data into a single coherent chronology

evidence.title: Philosophy of Cosmology (SEP)
evidence.finding: The convergence of independent chronological methods — radiometric dating, cosmic microwave background analysis, dendrochronology, ice cores, and genetic molecular clocks — provides mutual cross-validation of the deep time chronology

scoreReasoning.correspondence: Each epoch is independently dated by multiple methods that cross-validate; the overall chronology is not a single measurement but a web of converging evidence
scoreReasoning.coherence: The full chronology is internally consistent: each epoch follows logically and temporally from the previous, with no gaps or contradictions
scoreReasoning.convergence: Broad scientific consensus; the only dissent comes from young-Earth creationism which rejects the entire framework without providing quantitative alternatives
scoreReasoning.pragmatism: The deep time chronology underpins all of geology, paleontology, evolutionary biology, archaeology, and cosmology — without it, none of these fields function
